hypothesis: The implemented phase-selective stock/proxy KV consumer can execute through the pinned full Gemma target-verification path, remain exact at stock boundaries, and retain positive net target-cycle savings after all shadow maintenance costs.

identity_assertion.method: Mechanically re-used from the hash-bound authoritative scientific binding and verified executable inputs; no digest was hand-transcribed from provider state.

bench.reuse_contract: Atomically claim the named available bench and read its current connection identity from runtime/gpus.json. Reuse the resident exact checkpoint, pinned image/source, and CUDA/compiler caches. Do not create, recreate, drain, or mutate provider lifecycle.

execution.first_action: Claim immediately and import the implemented driver in the pinned target runtime; the exact-runtime call is the integration check, so add no new offline readiness or audit gate.
execution.component_contract: Run the still-unconsumed full-model component sequence and exactness gates from DIRECTOR_PHASE_SELECTIVE_FULL_MODEL_H200_BINDING.json with one resident target model and the hash-bound production dual-cache driver.
execution.repair_policy: Ordinary import, path, process-start, source-binding, graph-capture, telemetry, allocator, or pool-API defects are recoverable inside the retained claim before a valid scientific component. Preserve settled inputs and rerun only incomplete producers.
execution.conditional_endpoint: Only after an exact positive-net component, run the already-bound contemporaneous exact-c32 stock/candidate endpoint pair. Preserve raw rows, token/cache accounting, failures, timing, and coherence sanity evidence.

required: Stock prefill and ordinary decode remain exact to the pinned full-model control.
All 384 logical TARGET_VERIFY rows use proxy-local KV only at converted layers while padded rows remain cache-inert.
Stock and proxy banks have matched allocation, shadow write, accepted-index retention, rejected-row free, and request-reuse semantics.
Post-accept stock decode is finite and exact to the bound same-model reference.
Gross target-cycle saving minus every shadow, dispatch, move, and synchronization cost is positive.

stop_rules: Return a typed semantic_or_cache_reject, graph_contract_reject, or exact_nonpositive_net_component when a scientific component gate fails.

Do not run the endpoint unless the component is exact and net-positive.
Do not claim quality preservation or deployability, train, alter checkpoint values, replay the completed permanent placement comparison, or weaken the stock-boundary gates.
